cross_fit_policy_tv.identity_requirement: All three fit outputs for one candidate/domain must contain byte-identical ordered heldout sample-identity vectors before any TV is computed.
cross_fit_policy_tv.aggregate: Concatenate the per-observation TV values from all three unordered fit-seed pairs, then compute mean, p50, p95 and max over the concatenated vector.
cross_fit_policy_tv.absolute_gate: mean <= 0.15 AND p95 <= 0.35 in each domain

candidate_domain_metrics.advantage_nrmse: Arithmetic mean of heldout advantage weighted NRMSE over the three fit seeds within the domain.
candidate_domain_metrics.policy_tv: Arithmetic mean of heldout AveragePolicy weighted mean TV over the three fit seeds within the domain.
candidate_domain_metrics.sentinel_macro_nrmse: Arithmetic mean over fit seeds of each fit report's macro mean across sentinel subsets meeting the frozen >=128 heldout-sample threshold.
candidate_domain_metrics.policy_inference_seconds_per_sample: Median over the three fit seeds of heldout AveragePolicy inference_seconds / heldout_strategy_count within the domain.

definitions.equivalence_band_application: At each ranked metric, compute the best value among candidates still alive. Keep every alive candidate whose value is <= best + absolute_band, or <= best * (1 + relative_band) for a relative band. Only candidates surviving that band advance to the next ranking metric.
definitions.absolute_gate_application: A candidate is discarded before ranking if any fit seed in either domain fails advantage NRMSE <=0.75 or policy TV <=0.12, or if either domain fails cross-fit mean<=0.15/p95<=0.35. No failed candidate can be revived by relative ranking.
definitions.inference_tie_break: Uses AveragePolicy, not AdvantageNet, because AveragePolicy is the production action-policy network; AdvantageNet is a training/behavior approximator.

selection_order_restated.metric: worst-domain mean heldout advantage weighted NRMSE
worst-domain policy inference seconds per heldout sample
active flop tokens among remaining V2 candidates

selection_order_restated.rule: retain C0 if it remains tied; otherwise lexical candidate id only as a deterministic impossible-last-resort ordering, not as evidence of quality
